IA No. 3174 of 2022
In 
WPMS No. 3500 of 2019
Shri Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.
Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, learned 
counsel for the petitioner. 
Mr. Suyash Pant, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State.
This is an application for amendment of 
the writ petition. The petitioner intends to 
add a prayer to the writ petition for 
challenging the Government Order dated 
08.03.2016 and to add the Secretary Home, 
State Government as a respondent no. 3. 
The application for amendment is 
formal one and is necessary for just and 
proper for adjudication of the writ petition. 
Hence, the application for amendment (IA 
No. 3174 of 2022) is allowed. 
Let the Secretary Home, State 
Government be impleaded as respondent no. 
3 to the writ petition. 
The petitioner is directed to amended
writ petition within seven days.
Mr. Suyash Pant, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State accepts notice on 
behalf of the newly respondent no. 3. 
Let the additional counter affidavit, if so 
advised, be filed within four weeks.
Misc. Applications (IA Nos. 3172 and 
3173) for taking counter affidavit and
rejoinder affidavit respectively on record are 
allowed.  Counter and rejoinder affidavit are 
accepted on record. 
List this matter on 31.03.2023.
 
(Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.)
 07.01.2023

Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Vinod Nautiyal, learned counsel, 
holding brief of Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, 
learned counsel for the petitioner appears 
through V.C.
2. Mr. Anil Dabral, learned Additional 
Chief Standing Counsel, for the State of 
Uttarakhand.
3. The writ petition was dismissed in 
default. Now MCC No.3175 of 2023 (For 
Restoration Application) is moved for 
restoration of the writ petition
4. The reason, as given in the 
restoration application, is that due to 
some inadvertence, the clerk of the 
learned counsel for the petitioner could 
not mark the case in the cause-list. 
5. Mr. Tarun Lakhera, learned Brief 
Holder for the State, has not raised any 
objection.
6. The reasons, as given in the 
Restoration Application, are satisfactory.
7. The Restoration Application, MCC 
No.3175 of 2023, is allowed.
8. The writ petition is restored to its 
original number.
9. Mr. Vinod Nautiyal, learned counsel 
for the petitioner, also submits that 
identical matter is also subjudice in 
WPMS No.3508 of 2019.
10. List this writ petition, along with 
WPMS No.3508 of 2019, in the week 
commencing 19.02.2024.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 27.12.2023
